title: Cart.total() does not apply tax
description:
Order totals are missing tax. For a cart with subtotal 100 and a tax_rate of 0.25 we expect 125, but total() returns 100. The tax is never applied.

Failing test traceback:
  File "tests/test_orders.py", line 11, in test_total_applies_tax
    assert cart.total(0.25) == 125
  File "src/orders.py", line 13, in total
    return self.subtotal()
AssertionError: 100 != 125
